d: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.
A conservative villager hates the idea of his son relocating to Russia for a job. However, when his son brings a robot to care for him, he develops an unlikely bond with the machine.
Things take a dangerous turn when the aftermath of a rave party causes three friends to get stranded on an isolated island infested with zombies.
A couple's vacation turns into a nightmare after they are harassed by a stranger.
Struggling with the loss of her loved ones, Nazuk becomes entangled with a gangster, planning to extort him and his associates for a reward of 10 crore rupees, setting the stage for a dangerous game.
Ajay, an aspiring policeman, borrows money from a moneylender to pursue his dream. However, he is unable to repay the loan on time and decides to be a part of a kidnapping scheme.
Two married couples are unsuccessful in conceiving and seek medical treatment. However, they end up in a complicated situation after their doctor makes a blunder.
Brave heroes embark on a quest for truth as India and Pakistan enter an airstrike war that threatens to pose deadly consequences.
Shashikant and Gauri get married in honour of his late father's will. But, marital problems soon arise when Gauri suspects him of having an affair, leading to a chain of misunderstandings.
Police officer Bajirao Singham and his competent colleagues must join hands and combine their efforts in order to save Bajirao's wife.
After inheriting a cursed ancestral palace in Mangalpur, Arjun hosts his sister Meera's wedding there. The decision unleashes a violent supernatural force tied to their family history.
